title: Coenzyme Q10 protects against atorvastatin-induced hepatotoxicity via attenuation of oxidative stress and functional modulation of CYP3A1.
authors: Abdel-Rasol, Mohammed A; Anwar, Mohamed S; Taha, Hoda A; El-Sayed, Wael M; AbdelRaouf, Kholoud
one_liner_zh: 该文研究辅酶Q10对阿托伐他汀肝毒性的保护作用，涉及CYP3A1和PXR的分子对接，但核心是药物代谢与氧化应激，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atorvastatin (ATO) is a widely prescribed lipid-lowering drug, but its use can be limited by hepatotoxicity, potentially linked to metabolism-related mechanisms. The cellular pathways connecting ATO metabolism to oxidative imbalance and apoptotic alterations remain incompletely defined. This study examined the roles of oxidative stress, mitochondrial-associated apoptosis, and the pregnane X receptor (PXR)-CYP3A4 axis in ATO-induced hepatic changes, and evaluated whether coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) could modulate these effects depending on administration timing. METHODS: Forty male albino rats were randomly assigned to four groups (n = 10). Group I received vehicle (5% DMSO + olive oil), Group II received atorvastatin (ATO, 80 mg/kg), Group III received ATO (80 mg/kg) plus CoQ10 (10 mg/kg), and Group IV received ATO for 21 days followed by CoQ10 for 21 days. All treatments were administered orally once daily. Hepatic outcomes were assessed using biochemical markers, histopathology, and Bcl-2 immunohistochemistry. Microsomal CYP3A1 (rat ortholog of human CYP3A4) catalytic activity was determined using a testosterone 6beta-hydroxylation assay. Molecular docking evaluated interactions of ATO, its lactone metabolite, and CoQ10 with CYP3A4 and PXR. RESULTS: ATO induced oxidative imbalance, evidenced by increased lipid peroxidation and nitric oxide alongside depleted antioxidant defenses, accompanied by liver structural alterations and reduced Bcl-2 expression. ATO significantly reduced hepatic microsomal CYP3A1 activity to ~ 29% of vehicle control (~ 71% decrease). CoQ10 co-administration markedly attenuated these effects, restoring redox homeostasis and increasing Bcl-2 expression, while co-treatment restored CYP3A1 activity (~ 90% of vehicle control). Post-treatment with CoQ10 partially restored CYP3A1 activity (~ 60% of vehicle control). Docking analysis indicated favorable binding of ATO and its lactone to CYP3A4 and PXR, supporting metabolism-linked bioactivation, while CoQ10 exhibited lower affinity, suggesting indirect modulation. CONCLUSION: ATO-induced hepatic injury is associated with oxidative stress and mitochondrial-related apoptotic processes linked to metabolism-dependent mechanisms. Functional impairment of CYP3A1 activity accompanied ATO-induced oxidative damage, whereas CoQ10 preserved enzymatic activity, consistent with hepatocellular protection. Early CoQ10 intervention provided superior protection, highlighting the importance of timing in mitigating metabolism-related hepatic damage. These findings provide mechanistic insight into statin-induced hepatotoxicity and support further investigation of CoQ10 as a complementary strategy to enhance statin safety.
abstract_zh: 背景：阿托伐他汀（ATO）是一种广泛处方的降脂药物，但其使用可能受肝毒性限制，这可能与代谢相关机制有关。连接ATO代谢与氧化失衡及凋亡改变的细胞通路尚未完全明确。本研究探讨了氧化应激、线粒体相关凋亡以及孕烷X受体（PXR）-CYP3A4轴在ATO诱导的肝脏变化中的作用，并评估了辅酶Q10（CoQ10）是否能根据给药时机调节这些效应。方法：将四十只雄性白化大鼠随机分为四组（每组10只）。第I组接受载体（5% DMSO + 橄榄油），第II组接受阿托伐他汀（ATO，80 mg/kg），第III组接受ATO（80 mg/kg）加CoQ10（10 mg/kg），第IV组先接受ATO 21天，随后接受CoQ10 21天。所有治疗均每日口服一次。通过生化标志物、组织病理学和Bcl-2免疫组织化学评估肝脏结局。微粒体CYP3A1（人CYP3A4的大鼠直系同源物）催化活性使用睾酮6β-羟化试验测定。分子对接评估了ATO、其内酯代谢物及CoQ10与CYP3A4和PXR的相互作用。结果：ATO诱导氧化失衡，表现为脂质过氧化和一氧化氮增加，同时抗氧化防御耗竭，伴随肝脏结构改变和Bcl-2表达降低。ATO显著降低肝微粒体CYP3A1活性至载体对照的约29%（约下降71%）。CoQ10联合给药显著减轻这些效应，恢复氧化还原稳态并增加Bcl-2表达，而联合治疗恢复CYP3A1活性至载体对照的约90%。CoQ10后处理部分恢复CYP3A1活性（约载体对照的60%）。对接分析表明ATO及其内酯与CYP3A4和PXR具有有利结合，支持代谢相关的生物活化，而CoQ10表现出较低亲和力，提示间接调节。结论：ATO诱导的肝损伤与氧化应激和线粒体相关凋亡过程相关，这些过程与代谢依赖机制有关。CYP3A1活性的功能损害伴随ATO诱导的氧化损伤，而CoQ10保留酶活性，与肝细胞保护一致。早期CoQ10干预提供更优保护，强调了时机在减轻代谢相关肝损伤中的重要性。这些发现为他汀诱导的肝毒性提供了机制性见解，并支持进一步研究CoQ10作为增强他汀安全性的补充策略。
